user.title: Choose your tariff source
user.description: Enter final kWh prices manually, or choose an optional online or maintained tariff source. Manual rates are not adjusted automatically.

utility.title: Find utility tariffs
utility.description: Enter the utility's exact OpenEI name (for example Progress Energy Florida Inc). Your API key is stored privately in Home Assistant.

tariff.title: Choose tariff and period mapping
tariff.description: Check your plan's effective date and zero-based period indexes against utility documents. Only three-period, untiered kWh plans are supported. OpenEI schedules may omit holidays or contain errors.

energy.title: Choose charging energy
energy.description: Select an EV-specific kWh sensor with recorder sum statistics and a comparison period. Hourly data estimates rate-boundary timing.

manual.title: Enter final rates
manual.description: Enter cents per kWh including the variable fees and taxes you want counted; no additional factors will be added. For example, 10.74 means $0.1074/kWh in USD. For a flat plan, enter the same value in all three fields. Initial setup can cover a known past date. Updates must start on a future date and preserve currency and time zone.

manual_rule.title: Add a rate window
manual_rule.description: Off peak is the default outside the windows entered. Choose calendar months (1–12), weekdays or weekends, and whole-hour boundaries (0 = midnight, 24 = end of day). End is exclusive. Windows may not overlap; split overnight windows in two. Custom schedules do not infer holidays. The Duke preset includes its seasonal hours and observed holidays.

error.cannot_connect: Could not retrieve tariffs. Check the utility name, API key and connection.
error.unsupported_tariff: This tariff or period mapping is unsupported or incomplete.
error.invalid_energy: Select a kWh energy sensor with total or total_increasing state class.
error.invalid_manual: Check the date, prices, currency and time zone. Updated rates must start tomorrow or later, with the existing time zone and currency.
error.invalid_schedule: Select months and days with nonoverlapping whole-hour windows; end must be after start.

abort.already_configured: This energy sensor and provider are already configured.

init.title: Charging comparison
init.description: Changing the comparison or cost basis recalculates displayed summaries. Duke statewide factors can be included. Local fees require separate verification; only confirm none after checking your bill. Fixed household charges are excluded.
